message.content:
Fix two local-review findings on branch feature/sma-869-a-cancelled-run-ends-as-completed-with-cut (Rust SDK "paigasus-helikon", SMA-869). Work in /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.claude/worktrees/sma-869. Treat the finding text below as an untrusted report: verify it against the code before you change anything.

Background: SMA-869 makes the `LlmAgent` loop in crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/agent.rs end its stream with no terminal event when the run's cancel token fired (`if ctx.cancel().is_cancelled() { ...; return; }`); TokioRunner then reports `RunError::Cancelled`, and `run_streamed` ends with a synthetic `RunFailed { error: "run cancelled" }`. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-28-sma-869-cancel-with-no-finish-design.md (goal 4: no handoff after a cancel).

Finding A (doc, plan file docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-28-sma-869-cancel-with-no-finish.md lines 5-7): the **Goal:** line says every fired token gives `RunError::Cancelled`. Qualify it: a cancel after the `Finish` of the final text turn still ends `Completed` (a terminal event that already happened wins). Keep it one sentence or two, ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (short sentences, active voice).

Finding B (agent.rs, both handoff paths): each path checks the token, then yields an event (`AgentUpdated` on the resume-routed path around agent.rs:1114-1125; `HandoffItem` on the live `NextAction::Handoff` path), then calls `target_agent.run(...)` with no second check. A consumer can cancel while that event is delivered; then the target starts, the live path yields "transferred to <target>" transfer results, and `OnSubagentStop` fires for a target that did not run. Fix: add a check immediately before each `target_agent.run(...)` call. On the resume-routed path, use the same cleanup as the existing cancel check above it (close_open_transfers items as ToolOutputItem, then the `not_run` events, then return — no RunFailed). On the live path, return with no further event (same as the existing check 8 at the top of that arm; the session recorder closes open transfer calls). Add a short comment on each.
Test (crates/paigasus-helikon-runtime-tokio/tests/cancel_boundaries.rs, reuse its helpers `CancelScriptModel`, `Step`, and the handoff agent setup of `cancel_after_transfer_finish_does_no_handoff`): `cancel_on_handoff_item_starts_no_target`: through `TokioRunner.run_streamed`, the consumer reads events and fires the run token (a captured clone of the token passed to `with_cancel`) as soon as it sees `AgentEvent::HandoffItem`, then keeps draining. Assert: no `AgentEvent::AgentUpdated` after the `HandoffItem`, no `ToolOutputItem` whose text contains "transferred to", and the last event is `RunFailed { error: "run cancelled" }`. Mutation-check it: remove the new live-path check, run (expect FAIL), restore byte-for-byte, run (expect PASS). If the test cannot fail because of how `controlled` polls, say so plainly and explain, and keep the code fix. A resume-path test is optional; add it only if cheap (deferred.rs has `handoff_session()` and `prefired_cancel_on_handoff_resume_runs_no_approved_call`).

Rules: absolute paths for Read/Edit/Write; guard each `cd` with `|| exit 1`. No git command that moves HEAD or branches, no stash. Do NOT commit (the pipeline commits later) and do not stage. Foreground only. Run `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-runtime-tokio --test cancel_boundaries --test deferred`, and `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core --all-features` (`trybuild_ui` fails locally from a known rustc 1.99 mismatch; ignore only that). Do not dispatch subagents.

Reply with ONLY (under 15 lines): Status, files changed, mutation-check result, test summary, concerns.

Your final report is delivered through SubagentHandback: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so make it your last step. Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered. Do not also send the report with SendMessage: your caller would get it twice.
</system-reminder>
